prompt:
Generate one high-quality cinematic 16:9 image for the specified section, not a generic slide or dashboard. No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, arrows, diagrams, interface, checkmarks, traffic-light statuses or readable documents. The compositor adds every semantic mark independently. Do not invent a completed publication, a live security test, a solved outing, approval or consensus. Fictional editorial staging, not documentary evidence. Rich material detail, carefully controlled light, credible objects and hands. Keep designated annotation zones visually quiet. Never fill quiet zones with invented panels. Reference images establish cast and room identity only; follow this section's camera and blocking.
VISUAL FORMAT: authority-nesting-map
TEACHING PURPOSE: Distinguish organizational delegation, operator scope and a person's request.
CAMERA: Oblique architectural model from above, depth contained at frame edges.
Architectural study in ivory paper and frosted glass on a pale warm studio table. Three elegant translucent boundary walls form a loose nested enclosure in the FAR RIGHT THIRD only; no labels, tokens, people or connecting paths. Gentle natural shadows, copper accents. LEFT TWO THIRDS are clean pale paper reserved for a precise nested authority map. This is an editorial model, not a real permission system. No locks or green success imagery.
COMPOSITING INTENT: Nested organization and delegated-operator boundaries on an ivory field, with the user's request outside and a separately bound grant. Containment communicates scope.
SEMANTIC AUTHORITY FOR CONTEXT ONLY, NEVER RENDER THESE WORDS: PROPOSED DESIGN / NOT LIVE PROOF. Separate three responsibilities. The person requests an inspection. The organization grants inspection of C seventeen, with read only arguments. An operator may approve an exception only within delegated authority. Approval cannot create power the organization never delegated.
